tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and screen ground. Dark (Ink) is the brand's home theme; light (Paper) is for documents, print proofs and long reading.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and form fields that sit on surface.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: A block that flips the ground, e.g. a Paper cell inside an Ink layout.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline grid rules between modules. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons; meets 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised (17:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on surface and surface-raised (7:1+ dark, 6.2:1 light).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Neon green, the brand colour: primary buttons, the big block in a layout, ridge lines on Ink. Only on Ink or as a fill with Ink text; on Paper it disappears (1.2:1).

tokens.name: signal-hi
tokens.usage: Top stop of the logo gradient. Only inside the original logo artwork and the Signal glow.

tokens.name: signal-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the logo gradient. Only inside the original logo artwork and the Signal glow.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Green text and links: 14.4:1 on Ink, 4.9:1 on Paper.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a signal fill (14.4:1).

tokens.name: pulse
tokens.usage: Neon purple. One block per layout at most; the Hu/man Gift, offers, highlights.

tokens.name: pulse-text
tokens.usage: Purple text: 5.2:1 on Ink, 5.8:1 on Paper.

tokens.name: on-pulse
tokens.usage: Text on a pulse fill: Ink (5.2:1). White fails here (3.8:1).

tokens.name: flare
tokens.usage: Neon orange. One block per layout at most; dates, events, urgency without shouting.

tokens.name: flare-text
tokens.usage: Orange text: 6.4:1 on Ink, 5.1:1 on Paper.

tokens.name: on-flare
tokens.usage: Text on a flare fill (6.4:1).

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: Neon yellow, the spark: small doses only (a sparkle, a numeral, one label strip), under 5% of a layout. Only on Ink; on Paper it vanishes (1:1).

tokens.name: volt-text
tokens.usage: Yellow text: 17:1 on Ink; on Paper it darkens to olive (5.7:1).

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text on a volt fill (17:1).

tokens.name: scan
tokens.usage: Tech accent for data, AI-search scores and UI states. Small areas only.

tokens.name: on-scan
tokens.usage: Text on a scan fill (11:1).

tokens.name: concrete
tokens.usage: Neutral block and the mid-tone of duotone photography. Text in concrete only on Ink (6:1), never on Paper.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Dark blue website section ground, alternating with Ink. Paper text 16.5:1, Signal 13.7:1. Added 2026-10-17.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Dark purple website section ground, alternating with Ink. Paper text 16.6:1, Signal 13.7:1. Added 2026-10-17.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Fixed near-black for print, social and module art that must look the same in every theme.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Fixed poster-stock white for print, social and module art in every theme.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring with a 2px gap in surface. Signal on Ink, Ink on Paper.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Oversized numbers (dates, steps, quarters) clipped by their module.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Poster and hero headlines, set in capitals.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Social post headlines and section openers, capitals.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Websites Google and AI can find

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: We rescue old sites and make them ready for Google and AI search.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: If something goes wrong, you call us and we put it right.
styles.usage: Running text on web and documents.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Domain and hosting stay in your name.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, vertical rails, metadata, coordinates.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Figures, scores, code and before/after numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and tight label stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Module inner padding at small sizes; card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Module inner padding (default); gaps between text blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop; poster margins.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between major page sections.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for everything: modules, cards, buttons, photos. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Form fields only, to soften the input box on screen.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status tags only. Never on buttons or cards.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Grid rules between modules; card edges.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Control borders, focus ring width, emphasis rules.

tokens.name: border-heavy
tokens.usage: The poster frame and the single heavy rule in a layout.
